newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein higher, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein higher, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices edged up in late trading on Thursday while crude palm oil sellers were holding back until the market returns to normal next week after the holiday season, traders said.

They said olein was quoted at 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, up from 1,445-50 rupiah at the opening. They said crude palm oil tenders were expected next week, as sellers were not keen to do business this week due to the prevailing holiday mood.
"Many players are still on holiday, and some plants are still closed," one trader said. Crude palm oil sellers are waiting for next week to call for tenders."
Traders said local olein prices were higher following gains in the Malaysian market, but added that prices could face some pressure when the market returns to full force next week.
"One reason why prices are slightly higher is because there are not many sellers in the market at the moment," one said.

Data from Belawan port showed that the KM Pershing left for Tanjung Priok port in Jakarta on Monday with 4,500 tonnes of olein, while the MT Bumagah left on Tuesday for Tanjung Priok with 4,200 tonnes of olein.
